visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a white and black plaid shirt with orange accents stands in a TV studio hallway. He speaks directly to the camera with high facial expressiveness and frequent hand gestures. The background features light-colored walls and architectural beams. (2) The scene cuts to a television set. The man and a woman in a light blue off-the-shoulder blouse stand in front of a large game show-style quiz board. The board displays text about summer muscle and skin issues along with numbered heart icons. (3) The man is now positioned behind a white curved podium in the studio. He speaks animatedly, gesturing toward the camera. A woman in a blue shirt sits partially visible beside him. (4) A male doctor in a white professional lab coat stands at a similar podium. He uses his hands to demonstrate a point while speaking. Several yellow 'surprised face' emojis appear in a row above him against the studio background. (5) Back to the man in the plaid shirt at his podium. He is telling a story, laughing and moving his arms enthusiastically. A female guest next to him also laughs. Floating laughing face emojis are edited into the frame. (6) The three main participants—the man, the female host, and the female guest—stand together on the set and wave cheerfully at the camera.
